name: Champagne 4-3-3
summary: Minimal structure, maximum individual freedom. A veteran midfield three controls tempo, the full-backs stay disciplined, and the front three are given licence to do whatever they want in the final third.
keyInstructions: One full-back attacks, one holds. Never send both — the counter-attack cover depends on it.
Holding midfielder on Defend anchors the shape while the Roaming playmaker floats.
Balanced everything: this system wins on player quality, not instructions.
Ideal for a save where your squad is stronger than your tactical patience.

recommendedProfiles.note: 85+ passing and dribbling. Arda Güler's profile is the archetype.
78+ defending and 80+ physical — he covers for the attacking full-back alone.
This is the slot to spend the transfer budget on. The system asks nothing of them defensively.

name: Inverted 3-2-4-1
summary: The treble blueprint ported to the FC 26 role system. Back three plus a double pivot as permanent rest defence, four attackers holding width and half-spaces, one false nine dropping into the vacated space.
keyInstructions: Sweeper keeper on Build-Up — he is the spare man against a two-striker press.
Wide attackers hug the touchline; only the CAMs come inside.
Narrow defensive width (46) with a high line: the back three defends the middle, the wide players recover.
Never let both pivots join the attack. Four in the box, no more.
weaknesses: Demands 80+ passing across the back three

recommendedProfiles.note: 78+ pace and passing. Pau Cubarsí and Jorrel Hato are the two best fits in FC 26.
85+ passing with Pinged Pass. Christian Eriksen on a free is the budget answer.
Dribbling and passing over finishing — a converted CAM beats a natural poacher here.

name: Leverkusen 3-4-2-1
summary: The unbeaten-season shape. Patient back three, wing-backs providing all the width, two free eights attacking the space either side of a target striker on every turnover.
keyInstructions: Attacking width 70 — the wing-backs are the only source of width in the system.
One Holding and one Deep-Lying Playmaker. Two of the same role breaks the shape.
Both CAMs on Shadow Striker so they attack beyond the target man in transition.
Balanced approach at depth 54: this system counters, it does not press.
strengths: Best transition shape in the game
Set-piece height from the back three
weaknesses: Loses the ball battle against a possession side

recommendedProfiles.note: 85+ pace and stamina. The single most physically demanding slot in any system.
Kenan Yıldız and Ethan Nwaneri — dribbling plus real finishing.
185cm+ with Aerial or Power Header. Chido Obi grows directly into this role.

name: Nerazzurri 3-5-2
summary: Scudetto-winning verticality. Five across the middle to win every second ball, wing-backs stretching the pitch on both flanks, and two strikers who only ever attack in a pair.
keyInstructions: Attacking width 74 with defensive width 44 — wide in possession, narrow the instant you lose it.
The two strikers must be a pair, not two of the same: one drops, one runs in behind.
Counter build-up. The playmaking CDM hits the channel the moment the ball is won.
Five in the box on crosses — the wing-backs deliver, the eights arrive late.
strengths: Overloads a back four with five attackers
weaknesses: Wing-back stamina is the whole system
Empty flanks when they push on
Struggles against a back three that matches it

recommendedProfiles.note: 88+ stamina non-negotiable. Rotate two per flank across a 50-game season.
80+ passing and 78+ defending — Ayyoub Bouaddi's exact profile.
One target man, one runner. Two poachers make this system stall.

name: Treble Counter 4-2-3-1
summary: Mid-block discipline and lethal transitions. Two screening midfielders in front of the back four, wide players tracking full-backs all the way home, and a direct release to the striker the moment possession turns.
keyInstructions: Deep approach at depth 38 — invite pressure, then release in three passes.
Left midfielder on Defend focus doubles up on the opposition's best winger.
Only three players commit forward on the counter: CAM, right-sided attacker, striker.
The pivot never both press. One steps, one covers, every single time.
strengths: Ideal for an underdog first season
weaknesses: Wingers must defend, which limits who you can sign

recommendedProfiles.note: Pace over finishing. Mathys Tel and Endrick both fit at a fraction of an elite forward's price.
The most thankless slot in the game — 85+ stamina and 70+ defending, dribbling is optional.
